text: I'm a childminder, I have an 11 year old girl staying overnight while her parents are away. Temperature is 38.3. She's had a runny, blocked nose and sneezing since yesterday. Tonight she keeps covering her eyes and says the light hurts, so I've turned the big light off. She's also much sleepier than normal, quite hard to rouse just now, and slow to answer me when she does come round, which isn't like her. No rash on her anywhere, I've checked all over. I've let her parents know and wanted to get advice.
